verdict.rationale: Anthropic's llms.txt points to a first-party hosted MCP docs server at platform.claude.com/docs/mcp, so an agent can connect to an official MCP endpoint. Its documented scope covers documentation only, not Claude API operations. The MCP connector and MCP tunnels are client-side features for connecting Claude to other servers, so they earn no credit for this server story. missing for 10: an official MCP server exposing API/platform capabilities beyond documentation, dedicated docs on the docs-MCP server's tools and setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
